rule: An entry is usable only when status=='cleared' with license_sha256 and asset_sha256 set AND license_file/asset_file (repo-relative, cleared files inside the worktree) whose bytes match. Hashes are machine-checked; that the rights are genuinely cleared remains a human/independent legal assertion. Code licence never clears weights/data/fonts.
